edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. Cant. Liber I 3

source_text: Quia meliora sunt ubera tua vino. Ubera Verbi doctrina est lacte nutrimens parvulos et solido cibo perfectos. Vino legis littera comparatur, quae aliquando inebriat ad litteram sine spiritu. Ubera Christi meliora sunt, quia gratiam et veritatem afferunt. Odor unguendorum tuorum super omnia aromata: nomen Christi et fama praedicationis eius universum mundum replevit odore.
pass_a_gloss: Because better are breasts your than-wine. Breasts of-Word teaching is with-milk nourishing little-ones and with-solid-food perfect. To-wine of-law letter is-compared... Fragrance of-ointments your above all aromatics: name of-Christ and fame of-preaching of-him whole world filled with-fragrance.
pass_b_english: [[For your breasts are better than wine >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:2]]. The breasts of the Word are teaching that nourishes little ones with milk and the perfect with solid food. The letter of the law is compared to wine, which sometimes intoxicates toward the letter without the spirit. Christ’s breasts are better, because they bring grace and truth. [[The fragrance of your ointments is above all spices >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:3]]: the name of Christ and the fame of his preaching have filled the whole world with fragrance.
